text:
Sophia Chen: Hey all — quick sync re: ARB / Platform Standards cadence. Proposal: keep weekly meeting but rotate a facilitator from eng-team leads, and shrink to 45m. Facilitator duties: run agenda, capture decisions in the RFC tracker, assign a scribe. Can people volunteer for the next 6 weeks? I'll update the calendar once we have volunteers.

Alex Martinez: +1 to 45m. Happy to take week of Apr 6.

Kai Patel: I can do Apr 13 but prefer a slightly earlier time for APAC folks (check TZ). Also +1 for a short pre-read packet.

Marco Rossi: I'll take Apr 20. Quick ask — can we add a 5m "rollout blockers" slot so teams can surface urgent deploy issues?

Lucy Park: Can we use a fixed agenda template so facilitators don't have to craft from scratch? Something like:
```
- 00:00-05:00: Quick updates / housekeep
- 05:00-25:00: RFC / design review (presenter + 10m Q/A)
- 25:00-35:00: Triage / rollout blockers
- 35:00-45:00: Decisions & action items (assign owners)
```
I can make a repo snippet for the template.

Anya Sokolov: I can shadow Marco the week before (Apr 13) to hand over notes. Happy to help with the pre-reads.

Jen O'Neill: +1 on rollout blockers. Also please add a mandatory "pre-reads attached" checkbox in the invite so reviewers know if they need to prep. And tag the RFC owner in the calendar description.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Platform Standards — ARB" recurring weekly (45m). Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/arb-standards. Recording ON, guests allowed: org-only.

Sophia Chen: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the invite to 45m, add the agenda template to the description, and set facilitator slots as: Apr 6: Alex, Apr 13: Kai, Apr 20: Marco, Apr 27: Lucy, May 4: Anya, May 11: Jen (placeholder). If you need to swap, please say here by EOD Thurs. I'll also ping ops to add the pre-read checklist. :sparkles:

Alex Martinez: Confirmed for Apr 6. Thanks! :thumbsup:

Kai Patel: Confirmed, will move meeting 30m earlier for APAC-friendly time and leave a note in the invite.

Lucy Park: I'll drop the template snippet into the docs repo and link it in the invite later today.

Jen O'Neill: Holding May 11 tentatively. I'll confirm by next Tue.

Sophia Chen: If no swaps by EOD Thurs I'll finalize and post the facilitator handover doc. Thanks all.
